item.description:
##The best way to explore the 10,000 Islands!
___________________________________
## Rates

- **Adult (Ages 13-61):** $59.00
- **Senior (Ages 62+):** $53.00
- **Military (Active & Retired):** $53.00
- **Children (Ages 5-12):** $29.00
- **Young Children (Ages 4 and Under):** Free
___________________________________
## Duration
3 Hours
___________________________________
## About
Our 10,000 Islands tour departs daily from the Port of the Islands Marina just south of Marco Island off Rt 41. Embark on a laid-back 3-hour boat tour, navigating the scenic Faka Union Canal and exploring the beauty of the 10,000 Islands. Keep an eye out for the local wildlife, including the West Indian manatees, Atlantic bottlenose dolphins, American alligators, and the almost 200 bird species that call this area home.
As you soak in the surroundings, our knowledgeable guides will share fascinating insights about the intricate ecosystem, the diverse wildlife residing here, the historical significance of this area, and tales of the iconic Fakahatchee Island. This experience promises to deepen your appreciation for Florida's coastal wilderness, leaving you with memories of a peaceful and  informative exploration.


The trip will take place on a 45ft passenger catamaran with partial shade and bench seating.
___________________________________
##What to Bring
Guests should consider bringing sunglasses, a hat, sunscreen, and water. Coolers and food are welcome
Snacks, Drinks, Beer, and Wine available for purchase at the marina ship store before departure.

# Arrival Information

-**Boat departs from 525 Newport Drive, Naples, FL 34114**

-**Parking is located to the right as you enter Port of the Islands on Newport drive across from the fire station**

-**Please be at the seawall next to the marina ship store at least 20 min before departure time.** 

Trips board 5 min before departing and everyone needs to present for the safety briefing.
We do our best to ensure that trips leave at their scheduled departure, so it is very important to be on time!
![Description of image](https://cdn.filestackcontent.com/TXb4CIpTO21wgBQWVbJ0)
item.cancellation_notes:
Customers will receive a full refund if cancellation is made more than 24 hours prior to the reserved tour time. Customers will also receive a full refund or credit in case of operator cancellation due to weather or other unforeseen circumstances. We reserve the right to cancel tours if there are less than six people. Contact us by phone to cancel or inquire about a cancellation. No-shows will be charged the full price.

![Description of image](https://cdn.filestackcontent.com/xvyE3t4QSM3ufZhzD2uA)

We’re  proud supporters of the  Florida National Parks Association. The FPA is a partner of the National Park Service that supports educational, interpretive, historical, and scientific research activities in South Florida’s National Parks. Visit our parks, donate, become a member.  Your support benefits Big Cypress National Preserve, Biscayne National Park, Dry Tortugas, and Everglades National Park.
